title: Planning a per-host failure memory names every request path it gates and the errors that start and end it, as gates before the start
goal: A planned goal that makes a tool remember a host that failed (a down window, a breaker) lists, before the start gate, each request path of the tool that reads or records it (the source page, its search, candidate pages, a made-up sibling, a redirect target, a pinned url's repository) and which errors start or end it (a connect refused, a timeout cut by a budget, an HTTP error, a corrupt record), with a gate for each the goal leaves open. Retrospective of SP-u5q37ds3: ST-y45iz7uh asked only the window's length; its review found five gaps in the paths and errors it left open (ST-ujgqyr35, ST-ecxt66tw, ST-k445avpw, BG-gx4wphry).

run:
import re,sys
t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
w=r'(failure memory|remembers? a host|down window|breaker)'
ok=False
for m in re.finditer(w+r'.*?request path|request path.*?'+w,t,re.S|re.I):
    if m.end()-m.start()<900 and re.search(r'timeout|connect refused',t[m.start():m.end()+400],re.I):
        ok=True
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
